content: To prevent vaginal yeast infections, it is important to thoroughly dry the genital area after activities such as showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for extended periods, as these can create an environment conducive to infections.
